original_score0: exact saved generic FP32 MSE and saved prediction; no new target query
l2_policy: CPU float64 sqrt(sum((saved FP32 prediction - FP32 epsilon)^2)) for every draw including0
noise_policy: one independent CPU draw per image/repeat, shared across both targets; image-specific seeds

analysis_policy.scope: Fixed selection40 t140 generic loss noise diagnostic
analysis_policy.primary: negative MSE, two-image patient mean; report all declared alternatives
analysis_policy.ordering: For each image average losses over the declared repeats, negate, then patient mean/max

bootstrap.units: patient stratified20A20B; same indices for models/scenarios/seeds/contrasts
bootstrap.uncertainty: conditional on fixed8 noise draws and development patients; not a noise-population CI

analysis_policy.AUC_policy: All8 individual draws plus prefix1/2/4/8; each prefix contrast against prefix1
analysis_policy.reliability: All28 seed-pair Spearman; disjoint1/2/4 draw blocks; descriptive one-way ICC(1,1)
analysis_policy.paired_change: Same image/repeat noise across targets; score_when_member-score_when_nonmember per patient
guardrails: selection40 already used for development, not an untouched test

MC averaging is an existing baseline, not new patient-structure novelty

SecMI/PIA have no external random noise draw in this implementation
